offset_note: Map content minus truth (east, north), metres: where this mosaic puts the ground relative to GPS. Measured from 48 NGPS fixes against GPS on flights 2 (2026-09-24: E -2.50, N +0.86) and 3 (2026-09-25: E -2.20, N +1.48); 95% CI of the mean +/-0.30 m. Valid around the flight area only. vo_ngps_fusion_node subtracts it from every fix.
